No re-run was attempted, no additional budget was consumed, and the unit was not changed to claim compliance.

evidence_grade_of_the_60800_figure.grade: reconstruction from frozen source call order + surviving inputs
evidence_grade_of_the_60800_figure.what_it_is: the 60,800 target-level input rows are RECONSTRUCTED by replaying the charging and batching schedule of the frozen source against the on-disk 96 batch records and 384 tapes, then cross-checked against the run's own recorded 60,800 / 33,158 / 1,171 / 1,024. The schedule is deterministic, so the reconstruction reproduces the recorded figures exactly.
evidence_grade_of_the_60800_figure.what_it_is_not: it is NOT a per-call persistent ledger written at the time of each forward. No such ledger exists for this round.
evidence_grade_of_the_60800_figure.untracked_early_attempts_note: any earlier, aborted or failed forward attempt that was never recorded cannot be recovered from disk and is registered as UNKNOWN, not as zero. Therefore 60,800 is a LOWER BOUND on this round's actual neural input-row consumption for the recorded successful path, and must not be presented as the complete precise historical consumption.
evidence_grade_of_the_60800_figure.consequence: the 24,800 overage is established independently of this evidence-grade caveat, because even the recorded successful path alone already exceeds the cap; the caveat can only make the overage larger, never smaller.

wording_tightening.significantly_reduced_bias: tightened. No inference test was run, so 'significantly reduced bias' is downgraded to a NUMERICAL / PREDICTIVE observation on the held-out rows of this post-hoc split.
wording_tightening.real_gain_from_representation: tightened. 'the 64-D representation still brings a real gain' is downgraded to a NUMERICAL / PREDICTIVE observation; no significance or generalisation claim.
wording_tightening.constant_dominates: limited to specific metrics. The 'constant level correction is primary' reading holds for the ALL_ROWS task metrics, where the intercept-only baseline already removes most of the critic's systematic under-prediction (task bias +2.253 -> -0.116, RMSE 3.230 -> 2.271). It must NOT be generalised to every metric.
wording_tightening.composite_late_residual_not_attributable: on the late-free composite residual the affine baseline beats the intercept-only baseline (RMSE 1.120 vs 1.663, bias +0.244 vs -1.271), so that error reduction comes from the representation and must NOT be loosely attributed to the constant.
wording_tightening.unchanged: all predictive numbers in sections 4 and 5 are preserved exactly as produced; only the inferential wording is tightened.

limitations: The R68 model repeatedly SAW these training scenes during its own training; the OOF split is OOF only for the diagnostic regression, not for the model. Not an independent confirmation.
OOF fitting uses different-period (held-out-scene) data than the critic's own training; this is a post-hoc calibration probe, not a same-training-budget fair algorithm comparison.
Original value = each row's SAVED rollout-before critic value; never re-forwarded or overwritten.
Only OOF predictions enter the main table; training-residual-mean-0 is not treated as success.
cannot_infer: Does not prove the critic is wrong, only whether a better affine predictor exists on this representation.
Does not show a baseline would improve the policy.
Does not establish the causal value of a message.
Does not identify the root cause of any clipping.

missing_or_undecidable.note: All required fields present on disk; critic input/value wiring verified end-to-end against the saved rollout-before values (max abs gap ~2e-7). No zero-fill, no guessed input, no re-run episode; nothing marked undecidable this round.
